placements.why: The envelope records a database migration decision — a core architectural choice about which persistence technology underpins the analytics pipeline. No existing strata category covers infrastructure or technology selection decisions, so this strata category is minted to hold such content.
placements.title: infrastructure and technology choices as architectural commitments
placements.frame: What technology and infrastructure decisions are being made, and what warrants them?

placements.title: performance as the warrant for technology change
placements.frame: How does quantified performance and cost evidence serve as the warrant for replacing an established technology?
placements.why: Both expressions cohere around a technology replacement (PostgreSQL to QuantumDB) justified through proportional gains — 10x query performance and lower licensing cost. src-1 performs the assertion with those gains as reasons; src-2 records them as the basis of a settled decision with a timeline. This is a thematic subject future envelopes could feed: technology migrations warranted by quantified performance and cost evidence. No existing leaf holds it.
